critique: The render now fits comfortably within the frame and preserves the essential Horns (Lines) language: black field, pale mint-white luminous strands, repeated line strings, and clearly evolving geometry from t1 to t4. The upper and right arcs read more cleanly than before. However, it still resolves primarily as an asymmetric crossed ribbon/starburst rather than a legible paired-horns form. The center is overpacked into a broad white knot that hides the individual strands, while the left-side bundle remains comparatively weak and fragmented against the dominant upper-right and lower-right arcs.

suggestions.why: Reduce string density so the central intersection separates into readable individual horn lines instead of a blown-out white mass.
Reduce Twister deformation to lessen the crisscrossing starburst behavior and retain cleaner, more coherent paired arc silhouettes.
